headline: Engagement tracking and multiple Plex accounts

highlights.title: Engagement tracking
highlights.body: Sessions roll up into plays: total watch time over content duration, so an episode watched in three sittings is one play and clicks under two minutes don't count. Each play lands in a tier from Abandoned to Rewatched, TV shows get a 0 to 100 binge score, and metrics refresh every 15 minutes.

highlights.title: Multiple Plex accounts
highlights.body: Connect Plex servers from different Plex.tv accounts to one Tracearr. Adding a server tests each connection path and shows which ones work. Existing single-account installs migrate automatically.

highlights.title: Tablet layouts
highlights.body: The mobile app works on tablets with side-by-side charts and multi-column stats, plus a violation detail screen that compares the streams involved.

highlights.title: Version display
highlights.body: The sidebar shows the running version with a badge when an update is out. Clicking it shows the release notes and the docker command to update.

changes.text: a plays vs. sessions chart shows how much interrupts inflate session counts
top content by plays and top shows by binge score
completion rate shows how much of what gets started is finished
`groupByDevice` option cuts device velocity false positives for VPN users
relay connections are skipped, ignoring bandwidth-limited relay paths
Android no longer asks you to log in again after restoring an app backup
geo rules match country name variations like USA, United States, and US
Tautulli resumed sessions import as one session
Plex login no longer shows a false connection failure from a race
Discord and custom webhook test buttons are back in Settings
duplicate violations no longer block database migrations
